nodes.name: Simpro Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives every Simpro webhook event (created, updated, status ...). Only a test record that is NOT yet in HubSpot is acted on. ⚠ No auth (known open finding, left as is).

nodes.name: Check Test Record
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow [SPL] Check Simpro Test Record: fetches the Simpro record and returns the event plus isTestRecord. Re-select the sub-workflow here after importing it.

nodes.name: Is HS Test Record
nodes.notes: True → name starts with 'HS TEST - ', sync it. False → skip (nothing is written to HubSpot).

nodes.name: Skip Non-Test Record
nodes.notes: The record name does not start with 'HS TEST - '. Ends here on purpose.

nodes.name: Route by Simpro Event
nodes.notes: Routes on body.name. Events with any other name are dropped silently (no fallback output).

nodes.name: Log Site Event
nodes.notes: Saves Simpro site ID + event type to execution data so runs are searchable in the Executions list.

nodes.name: Log Customer Event
nodes.notes: Saves Simpro customer ID + event type to execution data.

nodes.name: Log Contact Event
nodes.notes: Saves Simpro contact ID + event type to execution data.

nodes.name: Log Quote Event
nodes.notes: Saves Simpro quote ID + event type to execution data.

nodes.name: Log Job Event
nodes.notes: Saves Simpro job ID + event type to execution data.

nodes.name: Get Simpro Site
nodes.notes: Fetches the full Site from Simpro (incl. Customers[] and PrimaryContact) — the webhook only carries the ID.

nodes.name: Get Simpro Customer
nodes.notes: Fetches the full Company customer from Simpro (incl. Contacts[] and Sites[]).

nodes.name: Get Simpro Contact
nodes.notes: Fetches the full Contact from Simpro (incl. Customers[] and Sites[]).

nodes.name: Get Simpro Quote
nodes.notes: Fetches the full Quote from Simpro using companyID from the webhook (incl. Site, Customer, CustomerContact).

nodes.name: Get Simpro Job
nodes.notes: Fetches the full Job from Simpro using companyID from the webhook (incl. Site, Customer, CustomerContact).

nodes.name: Upsert Site in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: creates/updates the HubSpot Site (0-420) keyed on simpro_site_id. Returns the HubSpot record (id).

nodes.name: Upsert Company in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: creates/updates the HubSpot Company keyed on simpro_customer_id with address, billing and contact details.

nodes.name: Upsert Contact in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: creates/updates the HubSpot Contact keyed on simpro_contact_id.

nodes.name: Upsert Quote Deal in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: creates/updates the HubSpot Deal for this quote. Returns dealId, used by all three branches below.

nodes.name: Upsert Job Deal in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: creates/updates the HubSpot Deal for this job. Returns dealId, used by all three branches below.

parameters.content:
## 🏗 Site event
New Site only: create it, then link it to the companies and primary contact that already exist in HubSpot.

## 🏢 Company customer event
New company only: create it, then link it to the contacts and sites that already exist in HubSpot.

## 👤 Contact event
New contact only (email and Simpro ID must match): create it, then link it to the companies and sites that already exist in HubSpot.

## 📄 Quote event
New quote only: create the deal and its line items, then link it to its site, contact and company if they exist in HubSpot.

## 🔧 Job event
New job only: create the deal and its line items, then link it to its site, contact and company, and to the quote it was converted from (label Job on the quote, Quote on the job), if they exist in HubSpot.

parameters.content:
## [SPL] Simpro -> HubSpot (Real Time): create and link only
The webhook is the only trigger. A test record that is NOT yet in HubSpot is created and linked to the related records that already exist in HubSpot. Anything already in HubSpot is left alone: updates come from the 30-minute Simpro -> HubSpot sync workflows. The event name does not matter (created / updated / status ...); existence in HubSpot decides.

**After import (manual steps)**
1. Connect `SPL Simpro` and `SPL Account` on every credentialed node; confirm no 'not connected' warning remains.
2. Re-select the sub-workflows if n8n asks ([SPL] Check Simpro Test Record and the five [SPL] Upsert ... in HubSpot).
3. Set Settings > Error Workflow.
4. Keep the webhook URL the same: import into the existing workflow (select all, delete, import) so the `hubsput-upsert` path and Simpro's webhook stay valid.

⚠ The webhook has no authentication (known open finding).
